description: Two ClientHellos, each cut 10 bytes before its end, inside the SNI. Only the reassembled record yields the full name: the extra rule for blocked.example.test alerts once and the allowed name does not.
extra_rules: alert tcp any any -> any 443 (msg:"TLS SNI of a blocked site"; app_proto:tls; app_field:sni=blocked.example.test; sid:9000001; rev:1; severity:medium; category:policy;)
